comment: Pinned recitation audio sources. Same NO-AI ZONE discipline as the text pipeline: bytes flow from these URLs into audio/data/ verbatim, are hashed into audio.lock on first fetch, and any later mismatch fails verification. The audio files themselves are NOT committed (see .gitignore) — the lock file is the committed truth. License basis researched + adversarially verified 2026-07-30 (see DECISIONS.md).
